title: bird usage payload
description: Shape of the data payload returned by `bird usage` under --output json. Reports API usage counts and cost estimates over a time window.

since.description: Start date of the reporting window (YYYY-MM-DD).

until.description: End date of the reporting window (YYYY-MM-DD).

requests.description: Total API requests issued in the window.

tweets_read.description: Tweet objects consumed (counts toward read quota).

estimated_cost_usd.description: Rough cost estimate using bird's local pricing table.

by_command.description: Per-subcommand breakdown keyed by command name.

source.description: Where the numbers came from ("local" for offline cache estimate, "api" for upstream metering).
